technical.summary: Mixed signals with strong short-term momentum (volume spike, three white soldiers, supertrend) but conflicting intermediate trend structure (below 50-day MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, weak RSI14) and overbought stochastic conditions limit conviction.

fundamental.summary: SWKS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 46 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market in fear state (43 Fear/Greed) with bearish sentiment (49.8%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (354+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (400.0), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and recent FOMC event create severely adverse macro conditions for tech equities; 46-day earnings window provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (15x volume spike, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) with price near support (115.05) in fear-zone market creates tactical entry opportunity for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising dollar, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), weak fundamentals (no insider conviction, high earnings risk in 46 days), and price below all intermediate moving averages (50-SMA, 50-EMA, 200-EMA, Ichimoku cloud) with overbought stochastic conditions make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Strong short-term momentum (15x volume spike, three white soldiers, supertrend) offers tactical appeal at support, but macro environment is severely adverse and existing SWKS position plus 58 IT holdings create concentration risk.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (400.0), rising dollar, flat yield curve, and high credit spreads create macro headwinds that will likely overwhelm short-term technical momentum; earnings in 46 days adds binary event risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding SWKS with 58 existing IT positions (18% of portfolio) in crisis-level macro conditions; adding to concentration violates risk management despite technical setup.
